lines.text: David takes refuge in the cave of Adullam, and about four hundred men rally around him as their leader.
David leaves his parents with the king of Moab, then the prophet Gad tells him to go into Judah.
Saul sits under the tamarisk tree at Ramah, and Doeg the Edomite tells him he saw David come to Ahimelech at Nob.
Saul summons Ahimelech and the priests of Nob, accuses him of conspiring, and spares Ahimelech after hearing him.

wrong_details.true: Saul says Ahimelech and all his father's house will surely die

lines.text: Doeg kills eighty-five priests at Saul's order, and Abiathar escapes to David, who promises that he will be safe.
